claim: In the matching retail DLL, MatchMisc.ApplyDamage (0x0600494D) has two Int32 parameters named atk_pl_idx and def_pl_idx and an exact 1,641-byte body. It returns when MatchMain is absent, the match-end field is set, or either Player lookup fails. It loads CurrentSkill and two exact Float32 modifiers, including the raw slot-24/25 exchange branch, then executes a pre-damage Audience block and an OutDamageCnt branch under their recorded raw conditions. At IL+0x01C5 it calls CriticalCheck(atk_pl_idx,def_pl_idx): the true branch calls def.Player.ProcessCritical(CurrentSkill) and joins at IL+0x04EA, while the false branch runs seven CalcDamage paths in the exact order HP, BP, Neck, Arm, Waist, Leg, SP, with the recorded modifier factors and Player mutation calls. The false branch also contains the exact HP/body-part zero-or-less flag, SP follow-up constants 3/2, 2048, 4 and 8192, InvokeUkeBonus, raw flag-64/spSkillFlags-16/mRate100Check(5) tree, and ringKind-1 isKO stores. Both branches converge into the exact bleeding-rate/mBloodSpTbl SP branch, raw flag-128 isFoul store, non-looped special/critical RecoverSP constants 256/1024, weaponAtkHitCnt update, FinishMoveInfo field updates, critical-received/counter writes, two isStarPeformance clears, and return. FACT-0014 already pins the caller boundary: UpdateAnimation IL+0x025F invokes this method under raw form flag mask 32 with plObj.PlIdx and plObj.TargetPlIdx.
